name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Magnetic Levitation Urban Transit
product_name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Magnetic Levitation Urban Transit
description: A surface-level magnetic levitation transit system that moves passenger pods at 300 km/h through elevated guideways above GLMZ's streets. The MLUT uses superconducting magnetic levitation to eliminate friction, enabling silent, energy-efficient high-speed urban transit. The elevated guideways run above existing infrastructure, requiring no surface footprint beyond support pylons. Zheng-Dao operates the system as a premium transit option connecting major commercial and residential hubs in the upper tiers.
social_impact: The MLUT has created a visible striation of mobility privilege — elevated guideways carrying upper-tier residents at 300 km/h pass directly over lower-tier streets where people walk or use improvised vehicles. The physical overhead presence of high-speed transit that lower tiers cannot access is a daily reminder of economic stratification, and the guideway pylons have become canvases for protest art and territorial marking.
story_hooks: An MLUT pod was sabotaged to derail at speed — the magnetic levitation failure sent the pod through the guideway barrier and into a lower-tier market, killing fourteen people.
Someone has found a way to hack MLUT pod navigation and redirect pods to unauthorized stops — a ghost station in an abandoned section of guideway that does not appear on any transit map.
